 There are five games in the Premier League on Sunday and BBC Sport will bring you every moment.
 Brighton v Brentford - listen on BBC Radio 5 Sports Extra 2 
 Crystal Palace v Liverpool - listen on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Ipswich v Bournemouth - live on BBC Sport website and app 
 Sunderland v Chelsea - live on BBC Radio 5 Sports Extra 3 
 Manchester United v Aston Villa (16:30) - listen on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Kick-off times 14:00 GMT unless stated. 
 Follow all of the action and reaction here 
 How to follow the Premier League weekend across the BBC 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement You can also listen to today's 5 Live Premier League commentaries on your smart speaker. Just say "Alexa, ask BBC Sounds to play Brighton v Brentford" or "Alexa, ask BBC Sounds to play the Liverpool match", for example. 
 [BBC]
 New this season: Live match updates 
 Fans of Premier League clubs can now get real-time scores live on their phone lock screen for every game.
 Simply follow your favourite football teams on the BBC Sport app for updates throughout the 2026-27 season.
